title: Purchase uncertainty and pickup impressions
summary: This topic clusters brief mentions about being sure or unsure, with clear praise centered on the buying and pickup experience but many fragments too incomplete to resolve into a specific sentiment or single aspect.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the overall car experience, the dealership sales process, and satisfaction after pickup.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly express uncertainty or incomplete comments about buying again, controls, voice commands, DCT choice, or access if needed, without enough context for a reliable sentiment label.

limitations: Many fragments are extremely short or context-poor, so the dominant signal is uncertainty language rather than a clearly defined product issue.
